احترتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرْتُنَّ (iḥtartunna) /iħ.tar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
# اُحْتِرْتُنَّ (uḥtirtunna) /uħ.tir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَارَ (iḥtāra)
